# 魏伯陽七返丹砂訣

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Wèi Bóyáng's Instructions on the Seven-Reversion Cinnabar*

attributed to [魏伯陽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%AD%8F%E4%BC%AF%E9%99%BD) (Wèi Bóyáng); annotated by [黃童君](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%BB%83%E7%AB%A5%E5%90%9B) (Huáng tóng jūn)

A Táng **alchemical instruction-text** on the **"seven-reversion cinnabar"** (*qī fǎn dān shā* 七返丹砂) — an elixir produced by seven iterative reversions of cinnabar — attributed to the *Cān tóng qì* 參同契 patriarch [魏伯陽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%AD%8F%E4%BC%AF%E9%99%BD) and annotated by the Táng Daoist Huáng tóng jūn. The attribution to Wèi Bóyáng is pseudepigraphic. Preserved as **DZ 888** / CT 888 (*Dòngshén bù, Zhòng shù lèi* 洞神部眾術類).

**Dating.** Táng. Dynasty: 唐.
